highlights.title: Talk to your agents
highlights.line: On a Mac, press the mic in a chat or a room to speak to your agents. Press the speaker on an agent's message to hear it read aloud.

highlights.title: Make a whole team at once
highlights.line: New Agent now asks if you want one agent or a team. Pick a ready-made team and Kosmos makes every member in one go.

highlights.title: Put work on hold
highlights.line: Hold a task or pause a project, and the Prompter and the Assigner leave it alone until you take it off hold or resume it.

highlights.title: Say what done looks like
highlights.line: A new project asks what done looks like, and warns you when two agents on it would both be coordinating.

highlights.title: One Kosmos per computer
highlights.line: Kosmos no longer shows a list of Kosmoses. The top left now names this computer.
